messages:
incident-bot: paging alex: detected sustained spike in 429 + token-accounting errors on /v1/generate across prod-west at 11:24 UTC, error budget breach threshold hit :rotating_light:

alex: acked. looking now. any deploys in last 10m?

maria: pushed a canary rollback for rl-config at 11:22, but canary was small. i'm seeing a large uptick in downstream 429s from internal service tokens.

jeff: timeline: release pipeline ran at 11:21 (rl-config v2.4.1). canary nodes seemed healthy, then at ~11:24 global rollout started.

taylor: confirmed alerts: dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/instances/prod-west/requests shows 5xx ~0.3% -> now 2.1%, 429s jumped from baseline 0.1% -> 9.4%. token-accounting log shows mismatch: missing exemption entries for services prefixed with svc-rl-

alex: hypothesis: new rate-limiter policy omitted internal exemptions (svc-*) so internal orchestration calls got throttled causing cascading retries and client 429s.

maria: can we toggle rl-feature flag to previous behavior? i can flip kill-switch if allowed.

jeff: i'm on the release window. recommend immediate kill-switch, then rollback if that doesn't sink traffic.

alex: doing kill-switch now. invoking admin toggle.

alex: ```
# kill switch flip (prod control-plane)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control.redwood/api/flags/rl-exemption-v2/toggle -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

incident-bot: action logged: feature flag rl-exemption-v2 toggled to false by alex at 11:28 UTC.

maria: metrics are improving on canary but global still high. rolling back v2.4.1 from global nodes now.

jeff: rollback initiated (release-job id: 2026-rl-1147). ETA ~3m.

support-liaison: notifying priority customers who reported latency via support queue. draft message: "We've detected a throttling regression affecting some requests and have initiated an immediate mitigation; we're monitoring and will follow up." :fax:

alex: after kill-switch + rollback, we're seeing 429s drop to ~1.2% and then to 0.25% over 4m. 5xx back to baseline. still seeing a handful of token-accounting errors in logs for retry windows.

maria: left a live patch ready to reintroduce correct exemptions (add svc-* to exemption list) in a config diff. prepping canary with corrected policy.

jeff: hold on re-deploy until we validate token counting for long-lived streams. we saw an odd accounting pattern: some tokens were double-counted when requests proxied through auth-gateway due to header rename.

alex: logging snippet of offending behavior:```
[2026-03-15T11:25:10Z] token-accounting WARN missing_exemption for token_id="svc-rl-orchestrator" route="/v1/generate"
[2026-03-15T11:25:10Z] token-accounting ERROR mismatch old_count=102 new_count=0 request_id=abc123
```

maria: ok, fix is to ensure auth-gateway forwards X-Internal-Token header intact and update rate-limiter to consult header X-Internal-Token first. pushing small change to canary only.

taylor: test plan: 1) deploy to canary with exemption fix, 2) run synthetic traffic (svc-rl token) to verify no 429s, 3) smoke for 10m, 4) gradual rollout with monitoring.

alex: running synthetic now from prod-canary harness. results: 10k calls w/ svc token -> 0 throttles.

jeff: rolling corrected rl-config to 5% of nodes. watch dashboards.

incident-bot: canary metrics for corrected rollout: 429 rate = 0.02% over 10m. logged.

support-liaison: sent update to impacted customers at 11:45 UTC. sample note: "Root cause: a rollout accidentally removed internal exemptions from the rate-limiter, causing internal orchestration calls to be throttled and generating client-facing 429s. We rolled back the change and deployed a corrected policy. No data loss."

alex: handoff to next on-call @jeff in 30m. summary for handoff:
- Incident start: 11:24 UTC (rl-config global rollout)
- Impact: spike in 429s and increased client-perceived latency across prod-west; internal svc-* tokens were not exempted leading to cascading retries
- Mitigation: kill-switch flipped at 11:28, rollback initiated 11:30, corrected config canary at 11:40, gradual rollout 11:50
- Post-mortem owner: maria (eng-runtime). suggested blameless postmortem and runbook update

jeff: acked. i'll monitor for 2h and own follow-up. can someone open a postmortem ticket with timeline and PRs?

maria: creating the ticket and will attach logs/graphs + PR for the fix. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/rl-config/pulls/487

taylor: add a runbook step: "verify exemptions for svc-* when changing rate-limiter policy" and add an automated smoke test for svc tokens in canaries.

support-liaison: queued a customer-facing incident summary for review, will send once PM approves.

alex: closing live page. leaving monitoring alerts on. if anything flares up ping #oncall immediately and page.
